items.title: Choosing a Science Project
items.text:
Mina: We have two weeks for the science fair. What should we make?
Joon: How about a volcano? It's easy, and everyone loves the eruption.
Mina: Three groups already chose that. The judges might get bored.
Joon: Then what about a water filter?
Mina: That sounds harder, but it's more unusual. Can we finish by next Friday?
Joon: If we buy sand and stones tomorrow, I think so.
Mina: Okay, let's do it. I'll make a list tonight.

qs.q: Why does Mina reject the volcano idea?
o: It would cost too much to build
It would take too long to build
qs.why: Mina가 'Three groups already chose that'라고 했으므로 다른 조들이 이미 같은 주제를 골랐기 때문이에요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about Mina?
o: She is afraid of building anything
She has already bought the sand
She thinks the fair is not important
She wants a project that stands out
qs.why: 심사위원이 지루해할 수 있다며 'more unusual'한 주제를 좋게 보는 것으로 보아 눈에 띄는 작품을 원한다는 것을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, the word "unusual" is closest in meaning to ...
qs.why: water filter가 volcano보다 'unusual'하다는 것은 흔하지 않다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Joon say, "Then what about a water filter?"
qs.why: 화산 아이디어가 거절되자 다른 대안을 제안하려고 한 말이에요.

qs.q: What will Mina probably do tonight?
o: Buy the sand and the stones
qs.why: Mina가 마지막에 'I'll make a list tonight.'라고 말했어요.

items.title: Bike or Bus
items.text:
Ella: Are you taking the bus to the library today?
Noah: No, I'm going by bike. It's faster, and it's free.
Ella: But the sky looks gray. I'd take the bus if I were you.
Noah: The bus stop is far from my house, so I'd wait ten minutes anyway.
Ella: True. Still, you'll be soaked if it pours.
Noah: Good point. I'll put my raincoat in my bag, just in case.
Ella: Smart. Text me when you arrive.

qs.q: Why does Noah prefer to ride his bike?
o: It is safer than riding the bus
The library is very close to home
A friend will be riding with him
It is quicker and costs nothing
qs.why: Noah가 'It's faster, and it's free.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does Noah think about the weather?
o: It will surely rain all day long
Rain is possible but not certain
The sky will be clear very soon
Weather never matters to him much
qs.why: 비옷을 'just in case'로 챙기는 것은 비가 올 수도 있지만 확실하지는 않다고 보는 것이에요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "soaked" means ...
qs.why: 비가 쏟아지면(pours) 'soaked'가 된다는 문맥이므로 흠뻑 젖는다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Ella say, "I'd take the bus if I were you"?
qs.why: 'if I were you'는 상대에게 조언할 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

qs.q: What will Noah probably do when he gets to the library?
qs.why: Ella가 'Text me when you arrive.'라고 부탁했으므로 도착하면 문자를 보낼 거예요.

items.title: Pool Rules
items.text:
Lifeguard: Excuse me, please walk. Running near the pool is not allowed.
Kai: Sorry! I didn't see the sign. Are there other rules?
Lifeguard: Yes. Shower before you swim, and no food in the water area.
Kai: Can I bring my goggles?
Lifeguard: Of course. But children under ten must stay in the shallow lane unless a grown-up is with them.
Kai: I'm eleven, so I can use the deep end.
Lifeguard: Yes, but take a break every hour. Enjoy your swim!

qs.q: What must swimmers do before they swim?
qs.why: Lifeguard가 'Shower before you swim'이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about Kai?
o: Kai can use the deep end
Kai is still under ten years old
Kai forgot to bring the goggles
Kai works as a lifeguard here
qs.why: 열 살 미만만 얕은 레인에 있어야 하는데 Kai는 열한 살이라 깊은 쪽을 쓸 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "shallow" means ...
qs.why: 어린이는 'shallow lane'에 있어야 하고 Kai는 'deep end'를 쓸 수 있다고 대비되므로 깊지 않다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does the lifeguard speak to Kai first?
o: To ask Kai about the goggles
To give Kai a swimming lesson
To show Kai where to eat
To tell Kai to stop running
qs.why: 처음 말이 'please walk. Running near the pool is not allowed.'로, 뛰지 말라고 주의를 주는 거예요.

qs.q: According to the lifeguard, what should Kai do after swimming for an hour?
qs.why: 마지막에 'take a break every hour'라고 했어요.

items.title: Which Fish to Buy
items.text:
Sora: I want a fish, but tanks seem like a lot of work.
Clerk: Don't worry. A goldfish is good for beginners.
Sora: How often does it need care?
Clerk: Food twice a day, and clean water every week.
Sora: What about the blue fish with long fins?
Clerk: It's prettier, but it needs warm water and a special heater. It costs more, too.
Sora: Then I'll start with a goldfish. Maybe I'll buy the blue one next year.
Clerk: Great plan. Let me find you a small tank.

qs.q: How often does a goldfish need clean water?
qs.why: Clerk가 'clean water every week'라고 했어요. 하루 두 번은 먹이를 주는 횟수예요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about Sora?
o: Sora is new to keeping fish
Sora already owns a heater now
Sora works at the pet shop too
qs.why: Sora가 수조 관리가 힘들까 걱정하고 초보자용 물고기로 시작하겠다고 하므로 물고기를 길러 본 적이 없다고 볼 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "beginners" means ...
o: people who enjoy cooking a lot
people who live close to a shop
people who work very hard daily
qs.why: 처음 키우는 사람에게 좋은 물고기라는 문맥이므로 막 시작한 사람들이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Sora ask, "How often does it need care?"
o: To learn how much work it is
To find out the price of fish
To check when the shop closes
To choose a color for the tank
qs.why: 관리 빈도를 물어 일이 얼마나 많은지 알아보려는 의도예요.

qs.q: What will the clerk probably do next?
o: Heat the water in the tank
Sell the blue fish to Sora
qs.why: Clerk가 마지막에 'Let me find you a small tank.'라고 했어요.

items.title: Practice Clash
items.text:
Ravi: Coach moved soccer practice to Thursday. Now it clashes with art club.
Hana: Oh no. Which one matters more to you?
Ravi: Both! Soccer has a game on Saturday, but art club shows our paintings next week.
Hana: Why not ask the art teacher if you can come late?
Ravi: Good idea. Practice ends at five, and art club starts at four thirty.
Hana: That's only half an hour. I'm sure it will be fine.
Ravi: I'll ask at lunch tomorrow.

qs.q: Why is soccer practice important this week?
o: Coach is leaving the team soon
The team has a game on Saturday
A new field has just opened up
Art club needs more players now
qs.why: Ravi가 'Soccer has a game on Saturday'라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about the art club?
o: It is only for soccer players
qs.why: 'art club shows our paintings next week'라고 했으므로 곧 그림 전시가 있다는 것을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "clashes with" means ...
o: happens at the same time as
is much more fun than a game
is farther away from school than
costs more money to join than
qs.why: 연습이 목요일로 옮겨져 미술부 시간과 겹친다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Hana ask, "Which one matters more to you?"
o: To choose the activity for Ravi
To make fun of Ravi's problem
qs.why: 무엇이 더 중요한지 물어 Ravi의 마음을 이해하고 해결책을 찾으려는 거예요.

qs.q: What will Ravi do first to solve the problem?
o: Ask the art teacher at lunch
Move the art show to Friday
qs.why: Ravi가 마지막에 'I'll ask at lunch tomorrow.'라고 했어요.

items.title: Lost Ticket
items.text:
Passenger: Excuse me, I can't find my train ticket.
Staff: Did you check your coat pockets?
Passenger: Yes, and my bag too. I bought it online this morning.
Staff: Then you don't need paper. Show me the email on your phone.
Passenger: Oh, right! Here it is. Is it Platform 4?
Staff: Yes, but the train leaves in five minutes, so hurry.
Passenger: Thanks! I almost panicked.

qs.q: How did the passenger buy the ticket?
qs.why: Passenger가 'I bought it online this morning.'이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred from the dialogue?
o: Paper tickets are no longer sold
The passenger is a station worker
qs.why: Staff가 종이가 필요 없다며 휴대폰의 이메일을 보여 달라고 한 것으로 보아 이메일 표를 인정한다는 것을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "panicked" means ...
qs.why: 표를 잃어버린 줄 알고 갑자기 겁이 났다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does the staff member ask, "Did you check your coat pockets?"
qs.why: 표를 못 찾는 승객을 돕기 위해 찾아볼 곳을 묻는 거예요.

qs.q: What will the passenger probably do next?
o: Wait for the next train here
qs.why: Staff가 열차가 5분 뒤에 떠나니 서두르라고 했어요.

items.title: Salty Soup
items.text:
Omar: I tasted the soup. It's too salty.
Lily: I only added one spoonful!
Omar: Maybe the broth already had salt. Next time, taste it first.
Lily: Can we fix it now?
Omar: Add water and a chopped potato. The potato soaks up some of the salt.
Lily: Really? That's clever. How long should it cook?
Omar: About fifteen minutes. Then we taste it again.

qs.q: What does Omar say to add to the soup?
o: More salt and a clean spoon
qs.why: Omar가 'Add water and a chopped potato.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about Lily?
o: She wants to throw the soup away
qs.why: 'I only added one spoonful!'은 그 정도로 짜질 줄 몰랐다는 놀람을 보여 줘요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "soaks up" means ...
qs.why: 감자가 소금기를 일부 흡수한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Omar say, "Next time, taste it first"?
qs.why: 다음에는 먼저 맛을 보라는 조언이에요.

qs.q: What will they do after the soup cooks for fifteen minutes?
qs.why: Omar가 'Then we taste it again.'이라고 했어요.

items.title: Picnic in the Rain
items.text:
Jisu: The forecast says rain on Saturday. Should we cancel the picnic?
Ben: No way. We planned it for weeks. Let's bring umbrellas.
Jisu: Wet grass isn't fun, though. Our sandwiches will get soggy.
Ben: Fair enough. What if we have it in the community room instead?
Jisu: That works! It has long tables, and we can still play card games.
Ben: Great. I'll call and book it today.
Jisu: And I'll tell the others about the new place.

qs.q: Why doesn't Jisu want to picnic outside?
o: The park is too far from town
The umbrellas are all too small
The others cannot come that day
qs.why: Jisu가 젖은 잔디가 별로이고 샌드위치가 눅눅해질 거라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about the community room?
o: It is always full on Saturdays
It has no tables or chairs
It is outdoors beside the park
qs.why: Ben이 전화해서 예약(book)하겠다고 하므로 먼저 예약해야 한다는 것을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "Fair enough" means ...
o: I am very angry at you
qs.why: Jisu의 이유를 받아들이고 대안을 내놓는 말이므로 상대 의견을 인정한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Ben say, "No way"?
o: He wants to buy umbrellas now
He does not want to cancel
He is afraid of getting wet
qs.why: 취소하자는 제안에 강하게 반대하는 표현이에요.

qs.q: What will Ben do today?
qs.why: Ben이 'I'll call and book it today.'라고 했어요. 다른 사람들에게 알리는 것은 Jisu예요.

items.title: Screen Time Rules
items.text:
Yuna: Can you play online tonight?
Theo: Not until I finish my homework. At my house, screens go off at eight on weekdays.
Yuna: Eight? That's early. Ours stay on until nine.
Theo: Maybe, but we have family dinner without phones, and I like that rule.
Yuna: That's nice. We usually eat in front of the TV.
Theo: You should try it sometime. We talk much more.
Yuna: Okay, let's just talk tomorrow at lunch instead.

qs.q: What happens at Theo's family dinner?
qs.why: Theo가 'family dinner without phones'라고 했어요.

qs.q: Compared with Theo's weekday limit, Yuna's limit is ...
qs.why: Theo는 8시, Yuna는 9시이므로 Yuna 쪽이 한 시간 늦어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "rule" means ...
o: a guide for what people may do
a list of the best friends
qs.why: 집에서 화면을 끄는 시간처럼 허용되는 행동을 정한 규칙이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Yuna say, "Eight? That's early"?
o: She wants to play at eight
She is happy about the rule
qs.why: 자기 집은 9시까지라서 Theo의 8시가 이르다고 놀란 거예요.

qs.q: What will Yuna and Theo probably do tomorrow?
qs.why: Yuna가 'let's just talk tomorrow at lunch'라고 했어요.

items.title: Two Museums
items.text:
Aria: Which museum should we visit on Friday, the dinosaur one or the space one?
Tom: Dinosaurs! They have a huge skeleton in the main hall.
Aria: The space museum has a planetarium show, though. It starts at noon.
Tom: The dinosaur museum is closer, so we'd have more time inside.
Aria: But tickets there cost more.
Tom: By three dollars. That's not a big difference.
Aria: You convinced me. Let's go Friday, and maybe try the space museum next month.

qs.q: What does the space museum offer at noon?
qs.why: Aria가 'a planetarium show. It starts at noon.'이라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did Aria change her mind about the museum?
o: The space museum was closed then
Tom offered to pay for the ticket
qs.why: Tom이 3달러 차이는 크지 않다고 설득하자 Aria가 마음을 바꿨어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "convinced" means ...
qs.why: Tom의 말에 설득되었다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Aria mention the planetarium show?
o: To argue for the space museum
To say the dinosaurs are boring
To ask about the ticket price
To say she will be late
qs.why: 'though'로 시작해 우주 박물관을 고르는 이유를 대려는 거예요.

qs.q: What might they do next month?
qs.why: Aria가 'maybe try the space museum next month'라고 했어요.

items.title: Spelling Test Tips
items.text:
Hyun: My spelling test is tomorrow, and I'm nervous.
Dara: How many words are on the list?
Hyun: Twenty. I keep mixing up "receive" and "believe".
Dara: Try writing each word three times. Then cover it and write it again.
Hyun: Does that really help?
Dara: It worked for me. Also, read the list aloud before bed.
Hyun: Okay, I'll try both ideas tonight.

qs.q: How many words are on the list?
qs.why: Hyun이 'Twenty.'라고 대답했어요. 세 번은 단어를 쓰는 횟수예요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about Hyun's attitude toward the advice?
qs.why: 'Does that really help?'라는 질문에서 약간 의심하는 마음이 보이지만 결국 해 보겠다고 해요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "mixing up" means ...
qs.why: receive와 believe를 헷갈린다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Dara say, "It worked for me"?
o: To brag about her high scores
To say the test is very easy
qs.why: 자신의 경험을 들어 방법이 효과가 있다고 격려하려는 거예요.

qs.q: What does Dara say to do right after writing a word three times?
o: Read it aloud to a friend
Look it up in a dictionary
Go to bed and sleep early
qs.why: Dara가 'Then cover it and write it again.'이라고 했어요.

items.title: A Gift for Jun
items.text:
Lena: Jun's birthday is on Sunday. What should we get?
Abel: A soccer ball? Jun plays every day.
Lena: Jun got one last month. How about a cookbook? Jun has been trying new recipes.
Abel: That's thoughtful, but books are expensive. We each have only ten dollars.
Lena: Together that's twenty. A good cookbook costs about eighteen.
Abel: Perfect! Let's go to the bookstore after school.
Lena: First I'll check the shop's hours.

qs.q: How much money does each friend have?
qs.why: Abel이 'We each have only ten dollars.'라고 했어요. 20달러는 둘이 합친 금액이에요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about Jun?
o: Jun has far too many books
qs.why: Jun이 새 요리법을 시도하는 중이라고 했으므로 요리에 관심이 있다는 것을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "thoughtful" means ...
o: hard to find in a store
qs.why: 요리책이 Jun을 생각한 좋은 선물이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Lena say, "Together that's twenty"?
o: To say the ball is cheap
To ask Abel for more money
qs.why: 둘이 합치면 20달러라 18달러짜리 책을 살 수 있다는 것을 보여 주려는 말이에요.

qs.q: What will Lena do before they go to the bookstore?
o: Buy a soccer ball for Jun
qs.why: Lena가 마지막에 'First I'll check the shop's hours.'라고 했어요.

items.title: Farm Trip Plan
items.text:
Teacher: Class, here is the plan for Thursday's trip to the farm.
Student: What time do we leave?
Teacher: The bus leaves at 8:15, so be at school by 8:00.
Student: Where do we eat lunch?
Teacher: At the picnic tables. Bring your own lunch and a water bottle.
Student: Will we milk the cows?
Teacher: No, but you can feed the goats. We return at two thirty.

qs.q: Where will the class eat lunch?
o: On the bus to the farm
qs.why: Teacher가 'At the picnic tables.'라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about lunch?
o: The farm will serve hot meals
The teacher will cook for all
qs.why: 'Bring your own lunch'라고 했으므로 점심은 각자 가져와야 해요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "return" means ...
qs.why: 2시 30분에 돌아온다는 문맥이에요.

qs.q: Why does the student ask, "Will we milk the cows?"
o: To ask for a lunch break
To say the bus is late
qs.why: 어떤 활동을 하는지 알고 싶어서 묻는 질문이에요.

qs.q: What should the students do first on Thursday?
qs.why: 버스는 8시 15분에 출발하지만 학교에는 8시까지 도착해야 해요. 가장 먼저 할 일은 학교에 오는 거예요.

items.title: Sore Throat
items.text:
Nurse: What seems to be the problem today?
Sam: I have a sore throat and I feel tired.
Nurse: Any fever?
Sam: A little. It was 37.8 this morning.
Nurse: That's mild. Drink warm water, rest, and stay home tomorrow.
Sam: Can I go to soccer practice?
Nurse: Not this week. Come back if the fever goes above 38.5 or lasts three days.

qs.q: What was Sam's temperature this morning?
qs.why: Sam이 'It was 37.8 this morning.'이라고 했어요. 38.5는 다시 와야 하는 기준이에요.

qs.q: What does the nurse think about Sam's illness?
o: It is not serious right now
It will pass in a single day
It is not really an illness
qs.why: 체온이 'mild'하다고 하며 휴식을 권하는 것으로 보아 지금은 심각하지 않다고 보는 거예요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "mild" means ...
qs.why: 37.8도가 'mild'하다는 것은 심하지 않다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does the nurse say, "Come back if the fever goes above 38.5"?
o: To ask Sam to leave now
qs.why: 열이 더 오르면 다시 오라고 돌아올 기준을 알려 주는 거예요.

qs.q: What will Sam probably do tomorrow?
qs.why: Nurse가 'stay home tomorrow'라고 했고 축구 연습도 이번 주는 안 된다고 했어요.

items.title: Finding a Call Time
items.text:
Emi: Can we video chat on Sunday? It's morning for you, but evening for me.
Mateo: What time is good? I wake up late on Sundays.
Emi: How about 10:00 your time? That's 6:00 in the evening here.
Mateo: Hmm, I have a swim class until 11:00. Could we do noon?
Emi: Noon for you is 8:00 for me. That's fine, but I need to eat dinner first.
Mateo: Then let's say noon. I'll send you the link.
Emi: Thanks! I'll set an alarm so I don't forget.

qs.q: Why can't Mateo talk at 10:00?
o: He has not got the link
qs.why: Mateo가 '11:00까지 수영 수업이 있다'고 했어요.

qs.q: What can be inferred about the two friends?
o: They go to the same school
They live in the same town
qs.why: 한 사람은 아침, 한 사람은 저녁이라고 했으므로 시간대가 다른 곳에 살아요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "good" in "What time is good?" means ...
qs.why: 어느 시간이 편한지 묻는 말이므로 '편리한'이라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Emi say, "I'll set an alarm"?
o: To wake up Mateo on time
To be sure she remembers it
qs.why: 잊지 않으려고 알람을 맞추겠다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What will Mateo do before the call?
o: Set an alarm to wake up
qs.why: Mateo가 'I'll send you the link.'라고 했어요.

items.title: Garden Schedule
items.text:
Pia: The garden needs water every school day. Shall we make a schedule?
Luca: Good idea. I can do Monday and Wednesday because I stay late for band.
Pia: Then I'll take Tuesday and Thursday.
Luca: What about Friday?
Pia: Let's ask Rani. If the answer is no, we'll switch every week.
Luca: Fine. I'll write it on a card and tape it near the door.
Pia: Perfect. The tomatoes will be ready soon, so we shouldn't forget.

qs.q: Why did Luca choose Monday and Wednesday?
o: He lives next to the garden
